def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])   # this instance's own log: the folder keeps every earlier one's
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def find_adjacent_3x3_solid(input_grid, special):
    """
    For each 3x3 window that is solid 1s (no special cells),
    check if it's adjacent to any special cell
    """
    window_cells = []
    adj_window = []
    
    for r in range(28):
        for c in range(28):
            # Check if 3x3 at (r,c) is solid (all 1s)
            is_solid = all(input_grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 1 for dr in range(3) for dc in range(3))

                continue
            
            # Check adjacency to special cells
            for sr, sc, sval in special:
                # Check if any cell in this window is adjacent to (sr, sc)

                for dr in range(3):
                    for dc in range(3):

                        if abs(ar - sr) + abs(ac - sc) == 1:
                            adjacent = True
                            break
                    if adjacent:
                        break
                if adjacent:

                    adj_window.append((r,c))  # window anchor
                    break
